item.title: Ripple Backs RLUSD Institutional Lending Fund on XRP Ledger
item.summary: Ripple is backing a new institutional credit fund designed to lend its RLUSD stablecoin to fintech and payments companies through the XRP Ledger, in a partnership with lending infrastructure provider Clearpool and credit manager Cicada Partners. The initiative is aimed at providing working capital to financial technology businesses through loans denominated in RLUSD.
